name: VeriWeb
description: VeriWeb is a verifiable long-chain web benchmark designed to evaluate large language model agents on complex, multi-hop web information-seeking tasks. It features 302 tasks across five real-world domains, emphasizing long-chain complexity and subtask-level verifiability with human expert annotations.
reputation: A very recent, specialized benchmark from the authors of the paper; it is not yet widely established as a community standard but is notable for its verifiable long-chain web-agent setting.
notes: Focuses on breadth- and depth-oriented search tasks; tasks decomposed into verifiable subtasks; highlights performance gaps in handling long-horizon web tasks.
